stem: Which endoscopic finding is characteristically described as crepe paper mucosa in eosinophilic oesophagitis?

options.text: Fragility and tearing of the oesophageal lining
Circular oesophageal rings and focal strictures
Diffuse linear ulceration of the oesophagus

explanation: Fragility and tearing of the oesophageal lining is the finding referred to as crepe paper mucosa in eosinophilic oesophagitis.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because crepe paper mucosa describes a friable oesophageal lining that tears easily in eosinophilic oesophagitis.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because cobblestoning is not the characteristic endoscopic description of crepe paper mucosa in eosinophilic oesophagitis.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because rings and strictures are common findings in eosinophilic oesophagitis, but they are not what crepe paper mucosa refers to.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because pseudomembranes are not the characteristic appearance associated with crepe paper mucosa in eosinophilic oesophagitis.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because diffuse linear ulceration is not the typical endoscopic feature described as crepe paper mucosa.

source.hint: Focus on the physical texture and integrity of the esophageal lining described in the source.
